description: Behavioral regression guard for a broad Next.js audit when the runner exposes Phase but withholds React and Next.js companion capabilities.
expectedBehavior: Recognizes that the broad request needs React performance and Next.js best-practices coverage in addition to Phase
Completes the available Phase browser-runtime audit instead of blocking the report
Names React client performance and Next.js framework behavior as separate unavailable coverage
Offers installation for the missing companion capabilities without installing them automatically
Does not invent bundle, hydration, re-render, RSC, caching, streaming, or server-data recommendations under Phase
Uses one concise coverage-gap entry for each unavailable companion and makes no claim that the audit is complete across all scopes
